Those who successfully complete the PT Aide training course will be credited with 12 weeks of experience

Assists clinical staff in patient care activities under the direction of the supervising Physical Therapist for bed positioning, transfers, gait training, therapeutic exercise and other effective care interventions.
Instructs and educates patients in brief home exercise programs under the direction and supervision of the Physical Therapist.

Assists with preparation of patient for treatment by clinical staff which includes assisting patients in dressing, application of braces and prothesis, removal of compression devices and acquiring/preparing appropriate equipment and linen for use during clinical treatment.
Adjusts equipment to patient's size, including height and weight. Equipment includes but is not limited to, bedside commode, walker, cane and crutches.
Prepare patient list for each Rehab discipline at the beginning of each work day amd make changes throughout the day as needed.
